c049.title: Cleaning day
c049.story: On Saturday, Max's flat is a big mess. He calls a [[cleaner]] and turns on his little [[robot]]. The cleaner, Oksana, puts all the [[plastic]] in the [[recycling]] bin. Old food goes into the [[compost]] on the balcony. She puts the leftovers in a [[container]] in the fridge. Max chooses a short [[cycle]] but adds too much [[detergent]]. Soon there are bubbles all over the bathroom floor! Oksana laughs and fills the soap [[dispenser]] with the extra soap. She changes the coffee [[filter]] and uses a window [[spray]]. Max tests the fire [[alarm]], and it beeps loudly. In the evening, the flat is clean and smells nice.

c050.title: A weekend at the dacha
c050.story: Anna and Max visit Grandma's [[cottage]] at the dacha. They drink tea on the [[veranda]], and Max sleeps in the [[hammock]]. A funny garden [[gnome]] stands next to the door. In the morning, Grandma goes to the [[garden center]] for seeds. She also buys [[insecticide]] for the bugs on her [[dahlias|dahlia]]. Anna helps her plant a purple [[iris]] and a pink [[azalea]]. In the evening, the [[jasmine]] and the [[magnolia]] smell sweet. Then Anna turns on the [[sprinkler]] and gets Max all wet! He laughs and says, "Now I am a flower too!"

c051.title: Taras wants a pet
c051.story: Anna's little brother Taras really wants a pet. On Sunday, Anna takes him to the [[pet shop]]. First they look at a big [[aquarium]] with orange [[koi]]. Taras loves the green [[iguana]], but Anna says it is too big. Then they see three little dogs. The [[chihuahua]] is tiny, and the [[terrier]] barks at everyone. The white [[poodle]] is calm and quiet. The seller says, "This one already has a [[microchip]]." She also says it has a gentle [[temperament]] and loves children. Taras smiles and asks, "Can we come back with Mom?"

c052.title: Games night at Grandma's
c052.story: On Friday, the family has a games night at Grandma's. Anna and Max start a big [[puzzle]] on the table. Grandpa does a [[crossword]] and asks everyone for help. Then they play [[bingo]], and Mom wins a chocolate bar. Grandma teaches Max how to play [[mahjong]]. Later Anna and Max play [[ping-pong]] in the basement. In the card game, Grandpa has the [[joker]] again! Then he plays chess with Max and starts with a clever [[gambit]]. Max fights hard, but Grandpa wins the [[endgame]]. At the end, Grandma reads [[tarot]] cards and everyone's [[horoscope]]. She says, "Max will win next Friday!"

c053.title: Anna the babysitter
c053.story: On Saturday, Anna is the [[babysitter]] for the neighbors' kids. Lev is eight, and Mila is five. Anna has a list of fun [[activities|activity]] for the day. First Lev dresses up as a [[pirate]], and Mila is an [[angel]]. They play a game about a scary [[monster]] and a slow [[zombie]]. Mila gets scared, so they make cards with [[stickers|sticker]] and [[glitter]]. After lunch, they go to the park and ride the [[carousel]]. Nearby, a [[clown]] gives free rides on a [[pony]]. At home, they make a [[collage]] about their day. Then Lev's big brother comes home in his [[boy scout]] uniform. The kids ask him, "Can Anna come again next Saturday?"

c054.title: Max on a dating app
c054.story: Max is single, so he tries a [[dating]] app. Anna helps him with his [[profile]] and his photo. Max asks, "Do I look [[sexy]] here?" Anna laughs and says, "Write about your hobbies, not about [[sex]]." Then Max sees his [[ex]], a real [[narcissist]], on the app. "She never listened to you. That was a [[red flag]]," Anna says. Suddenly Max gets a message from Lina, his [[crush]] from the gym! She studies history and invites him to a [[rendezvous]] at the museum. She shows him a [[fetish]], a holy wooden object from long ago. Max smiles: maybe this is the start of a [[love story]].

c055.title: Sofia's coming out
c055.story: On Sunday, Max's sister Sofia invites the whole family for dinner. She is nervous, because this dinner is her [[coming out]]. "I am [[queer]]," she says, "and I want you to meet my [[partner]], Dana." For a moment the room is quiet, and then Max gives his sister a big hug. Grandma asks many questions, and Dana kindly explains [[gender]] and what [[LGBT]] means. Dad admits that he believed an old [[stereotype]] from TV. Mom says that in her family, talking about feelings was always a [[taboo]]. "Not in this family," Grandma says, and she pours tea for Dana first. Max raises his glass: "To Sofia and Dana, with love and [[respect]]!"

c056.title: Cousin Olya's wedding
c056.story: Anna's cousin Olya gets married on Saturday. An event [[coordinator]] plans everything for the big day. The [[banquet]] is in a beautiful old hotel. The [[catering]] is excellent, and the cake is huge. Olya wears a white dress and a small silver [[tiara]]. Max films everything with his dad's old [[video camera]]. The groom's friend Ian is from Scotland, and he wears a [[kilt]]. Ian makes a funny [[speech]]. Then he acts like a [[buffoon]] with a flower on his head! Later the [[DJ]] plays a slow [[waltz]] for the happy couple. Grandma says, "This is the best party since the new [[millennium]]!" Olya smiles: "I will remember this day [[forever]]."

c057.title: Max's job interview
c057.story: Max is a student, but he wants a [[part-time]] job. He dreams of becoming a [[software engineer]]. On Monday, a [[recruiter]] from an IT company calls him. On Wednesday, Max wears his new [[blazer]] to the interview. The [[interviewer]] is a friendly woman named Iryna. She asks about his [[skills|skill]] in coding. Then she asks about teamwork, an important [[soft skill]]. Max shows his [[portfolio]] with three small apps. He asks about every [[aspect]] of the job, like hours and pay. Two days later, Max gets an [[offer]]! On Friday, he reads the [[contract]] carefully and signs it.

c058.title: Max's first day at work
c058.story: It is Friday, Max's first day at the [[office]]. A woman from [[HR]] gives him a [[badge]]. He meets his [[boss]] and the [[office manager]]. Kate, the [[assistant]], tells him about the [[dress code]]. Max looks down at his old jeans. Kate laughs: "Jeans are OK on Fridays!" At ten, the [[training]] starts in the [[meeting room]]. But Max's computer does not work. The [[administrator]] comes and helps him fast. Max thinks, "I like this new job."

c059.title: A new project
c059.story: It is a busy [[period]] at Max's work. The team [[leader]], Olena, starts a new [[project]] for a big [[client]]. The [[manager]], Pavlo, gives Max his first [[task]] with a Friday [[deadline]]. Pavlo writes every [[milestone]] on the team [[wiki]]. Max also makes his own [[checklist]] with ten small steps. He works with great [[enthusiasm]]. He even sets three alarms for one meeting. Pavlo laughs: "Three alarms? That is [[overkill]]!" On Thursday, Max finishes everything early, and the client is happy.

c060.title: Max's first presentation
c060.story: On Monday, Max gives his first presentation to the client. He is nervous, and the [[projector]] does not turn on at first. Finally, his first [[slide]] appears on the wall. Max talks about a [[document]] on the client's new delivery [[service]]. The client listens carefully and asks many questions. The next day, she sends her [[feedback]] in a long email. Then her team sends a [[follow-up]] with some useful [[insights|insight]]. They like the [[impact]] of the work on their sales. They ask for a [[deep dive]] into the numbers next week. Max smiles: his first presentation was a success.
